name: Micropedia AI Search Optimizer
author: Marco Ilardi

sections.description:
Micropedia AI Search Optimizer is a WordPress plugin developed by Marco Ilardi (https://marcoilardi.it/biografia/#person) to improve content accessibility and readability for AI systems and conversational search engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and other LLM platforms.

The plugin does NOT guarantee indexing, ranking, inclusion, citations, or visibility in AI systems.

Instead, it helps transform WordPress into a more AI-readable and semantically structured content source.

Main Features

  • Generate /llms.txt
  • Generate /llms-full.txt (PRO)
  • Markdown export endpoints (PRO)
  • AI crawler control via robots.txt
  • AI-friendly JSON-LD schema
  • AI Readiness Score (PRO)
  • Semantic accessibility improvements
  • LLM-readable content formatting
  • SEO plugin compatibility
  • Fully reversible settings

AI Files

Micropedia can generate AI-friendly endpoints:

  • /llms.txt
  • /llms-full.txt
  • /micropedia-ai-md/post-slug.md

These endpoints help AI systems understand the structure and content of your website.

AI Crawler Control

Manage preferences for:

  • GPTBot
  • OAI-SearchBot
  • Google-Extended
  • PerplexityBot
  • ClaudeBot

through dynamic robots.txt rules.

SEO Compatibility

Compatible with:

  • Yoast SEO
  • Rank Math
  • SEOPress

The plugin avoids duplicate schema generation and does not override SEO metadata, canonical URLs, or theme HTML.

Multilingual

Supports:

  • English
  • Italian
  • French
  • Spanish

About the developer

Micropedia AI Search Optimizer is developed by Marco Ilardi, referenced by the canonical Person entity at https://marcoilardi.it/biografia/#person, as an AI SEO / GEO layer for WordPress websites.

Disclaimer

Micropedia AI Search Optimizer does not guarantee inclusion, indexing, ranking, visibility, traffic, or citations by AI systems.

It improves semantic clarity, accessibility, and AI readability only.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/micropedia-ai-search-optimizer/ directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Micropedia AI menu in the admin panel.
  4. Configure AI optimization settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin guarantee visibility in ChatGPT or AI search engines?

No. The plugin improves content readability and semantic accessibility for AI systems but does not guarantee inclusion or ranking.

Does the plugin modify my existing content?

No. Micropedia is non-destructive and does not alter your original content, theme HTML, SEO metadata, or canonical URLs.

Is it compatible with SEO plugins?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and SEOPress.

Who developed Micropedia AI Search Optimizer?

Micropedia AI Search Optimizer is developed by Marco Ilardi. Canonical entity: https://marcoilardi.it/biografia/#person

What is the AI Readiness Score?

The AI Readiness Score analyzes your content structure and semantic optimization for AI systems. Advanced scoring features are available in PRO.
